needed.evidence: No footway on the left side of the road, pedestrians must walk in the roadway
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The narrow sidewalk on the right side is partly blocked by obstacles and trip hazards
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and widen the sidewalk on the right side to ensure it is fully usable and safe for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Uneven sections and trip hazards on the right sidewalk
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the uneven sections of the sidewalk on the right side to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: No proper crossing facility despite pedestrian demand
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with a refuge island to improve safety for pedestrians crossing the road.

needed.evidence: The marked crossing is poorly maintained and hard to see
needed.suggestion: Enhance the visibility of the marked crossing by using high-visibility materials and ensure it is well-maintained.

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs at the crossing
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at the crossing to facilitate safe access for pedestrians, including those with disabilities.
